On September 15, 2025, the reporting person was granted an award of restricted stock units ("RSUs") which shall vest upon satisfaction of several performance criteria. Certain of these performance criteria were met on 10/29/2026, resulting in vesting of the RSUs as to 5,000 ordinary shares.
